title: Open and measure 3MF through the native engine
scope: Wire 3MF into the real scan.open worker/session and native info/fit-plane CLI: millimetre units whatever is given (prepareScan), status prefix from the given units, vertex colours kept when there is one per graph vertex (postScan, scanColors), texture notes (scanFileNote) and bounded source refusals. Matches the no-viewport original, where scanCompanions' createImageBitmap decode is unavailable so packed images never reach the reader. Also: CLI info on a .scanruler lists the reopened elements (id, kind, name, status).
acceptance: 3MF opens through the engine with original-equivalent mesh, summary, source and session state on success and refusal; a wrong Rust value fails the comparison.
CLI supplies files and formats results while the engine owns parsing, state and measurements.
open_items: Native-import comparison: 62/62 pass against the pinned original (48 existing + 14 new 3MF cases: units mm/cm/in, deflated, inch/centimeter model units, build transforms, components, base-material colours, packed texture, no model, no triangles, bad index, damaged). Fixtures from fixtures/native-import/generate-3mf.py. A wrong Rust value (3MF position +0.5 before scaling) fails all 10 geometry cases; the 4 refusal cases are rightly unaffected.
Packed images are not decoded natively, matching the headless original. A browser build that has createImageBitmap would decode them (port-io png.rs is ready for PNG; JPEG is not ported).
Verification label and roster registration wait for the owner-scheduled M3 milestone batch (2026-11-05 verification budget).
